slices.focus: Workflow overhaul extends into pickup scheduling and day-coded collection shelving
slices.summary: With prep side improved, Saira tackles after-school collection bottlenecks. She introduces a text-ready rhythm for selected repeat patients, day-coded then surname-block collection shelves, and a compact prompt card. Early results show quicker retrievals and one patient compliment.
open_loops: Staff confidence in the new shelf logic needs to be built
Patient text script needs softening to avoid sounding bossy
One-snag staff check-in not yet done
Edge cases (early/late patients) need clearer handling
decisions: Saira remained operations lead and extended her workflow overhaul into pickup scheduling and day-coded collection shelvi
